parameters.name: ComponentId
parameters.description: The ID of the application subcomponent. If you specify this parameter, the whitelist modification takes effect only for this subcomponent.

parameters.name: ModifyMode
parameters.description:
The method to modify the whitelist. Valid values:

- **Cover**: Overwrites the original IP address whitelist. This is the default value.

- **Append**: Appends IP addresses.

- **Delete**: Deletes IP addresses.

parameters.name: SecurityGroups
parameters.description: The list of security group IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas.

parameters.name: SecurityIPArrayName
parameters.description: The name of the IP address group. The default value is `default`.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description: The IP addresses for the whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas.
